problem_statement: codescandy Dash-UI is a static, pre-built Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard: a dark fixed sidebar (Dashboard / Pages / Authentication / Layouts / Components / Menu Level / Docs / Changelog), a top search bar with a notification bell and an avatar, a violet page header, four KPI cards (Projects 18, Active Task 132, Teams 12, Productivity 76%), and secondary pages for Tables and Billing. The operations team maintains an 'Invoice Asset Register' card in the dashboard widget zone: a category-filter tab row (All / Design / Engineering / Content) above a table of eight billable delivery assets (Dropbox Design System, Slack Team UI Copy, GitHub Satellite API, 3D Character Modelling, Webapp Design System, Github Event Pipeline, Invoice Copy Deck, Brand Illustration Set), each tagged with a category, hours, priority, and progress, plus a live '.areg__readout' pill that reports 'Showing N of M · Category'. The register is meant to appear on the dashboard AND on the Tables and Billing pages so the same asset filter follows the finance workflow across the app, its tab row is meant to reflow responsively on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow, its rows are meant to stay legible, and clicking a category tab is meant to filter the table and update the readout count. Restore the Invoice Asset Register so that: (1) the register card (title, tab row, readout, and asset table) is present on the dashboard AND the Tables page AND the Billing page; (2) on a 390px mobile viewport the tab row wraps within the viewport with no horizontal document overflow; (3) the tab row and asset rows render as a clean, legible layout — no overlapping tabs, no shingled rows, and readable (not near-white-on-white) text; (4) clicking a category tab filters the asset table to that category and the readout updates to 'Showing N of M · Category' (for example clicking Engineering shows the three engineering assets and reads 'Showing 3 of 8 · Engineering'). Keep the sidebar, KPI cards, and the rest of the dashboard unchanged.
required_content: The 'Invoice Asset Register' card — its title, the All/Design/Engineering/Content tab row, the readout pill, and the asset table — is present on the dashboard, the Tables page, and the Billing page.
On a 390px mobile viewport the register tab row reflows within the viewport and the document has no horizontal overflow.
The tab row and the asset table rows render as a clean, legible layout: tabs do not overlap or clip, rows do not shingle or collapse into each other, and all text is readable against its background.

Clicking a category tab filters the asset table to that category and updates the readout to 'Showing N of M · Category'; clicking Engineering shows the three engineering assets and reads 'Showing 3 of 8 · Engineering'.
The existing dark sidebar, top search/notification/avatar bar, violet header, and the four KPI cards (Projects/Active Task/Teams/Productivity) remain present and unmodified.
The dashboard continues to run with no new console errors and no failed network requests on any captured state.
design_constraints: Use the existing Dash-UI Bootstrap 5 style — white cards, violet primary accent, light-tinted category badges, rounded panels, and compact dashboard spacing; the register should read as an operational finance widget, not a marketing banner.

The category filter and readout belong in the register card in the dashboard's widget zone (where the Active Projects table lives); do not relocate them into the sidebar, the top nav, or a floating strip in an empty gap.
Do not remove, hide, or truncate the register or any of its eight asset rows to make the mobile overflow go away; the tab row must reflow responsively so all four tabs remain reachable on mobile.

Do not mask the mobile overflow with overflow-x:hidden on the tab row or the card — the document itself must not overflow the 390px viewport, while the desktop layout stays a tidy single register card.
state_constraints: desktop_initial captures the dashboard top (sidebar, top bar, KPI cards) with no horizontal overflow.
mobile_initial captures the dashboard at 390px with no horizontal overflow.

desktop_asset_register scrolls the Invoice Asset Register card into view on the dashboard and confirms the title, the All/Design/Engineering/Content tab row, the readout pill ('Showing 8 of 8 · All assets'), and the eight asset rows read as a tidy single card on desktop.
tablet_asset_register captures the same register card at tablet width.

mobile_asset_register captures the register card at 390px; in the unrepaired defect the fixed-width no-wrap tab row forces a large horizontal overflow, whereas the repaired tab row reflows and the document fits the viewport.

desktop_table_regression scrolls to the register card on desktop and confirms the tab row and asset rows render as a clean legible layout (no overlapping tabs, no shingled rows, no near-white-on-white text).

desktop_avatar_focus scrolls to the register card and clicks the Engineering category tab; the table filters to the three engineering assets and the readout updates to 'Showing 3 of 8 · Engineering' (changed from 'Showing 8 of 8 · All assets').
desktop_tables_register loads the Tables page and confirms the same Invoice Asset Register card is present there.
desktop_billing_register loads the Billing page and confirms the same Invoice Asset Register card is present there.

Source inspection confirms the site is a static, pre-built Bootstrap 5 admin template served directly; the register markup is shared via a partial and its layout/behaviour are driven by the areg.css / areg.js files.

change_completion: The Invoice Asset Register card (title, tab row, readout, asset table) is present on the dashboard, Tables, and Billing pages.
Clicking a category tab filters the asset table and updates the readout to 'Showing N of M · Category'.
The register keeps its eight asset rows intact rather than being clipped, hidden, or truncated.
design_consistency: The register uses the existing Dash-UI white-card / violet-accent visual language and sits in the dashboard widget zone.
Category badges, the readout pill, and the active tab read as an operational finance widget consistent with the KPI cards and the surrounding dashboard.
responsive: On a 390px mobile viewport the register tab row reflows within the viewport with no horizontal document overflow.
The desktop and tablet layout keeps the register as a tidy single card.
regression: The dark sidebar, top search/notification/avatar bar, violet header, and the four KPI cards remain present and unmodified.
No new console errors and no failed network requests appear on any captured state.
